description:
Preferred
 
• At least 4 years of experience in software development working with various technologies like Java 1.5+, Spring 3.0 or above, Web Services - SOAP or REST, JSP, Servlet, Eclipse, HTML, IBM WebSphere/JBoss Application Server, SQL. 
• Candidate should have exposure to Jira, Maven, and SOAP UI will be preferred.
• At least 2 years of experience in Big Data technology stack HDFS (MapR distribution), Map Reduce using Java, PIG, Hive.
• Knowledge of data modeling in NOSQL HBase is required.
• Atleast 2 years of experience on Python
• Candidate should have had exposure to Credit Risk domain or Fraud analytics domain
• At least 2 years of experience working in Global Delivery model- i.e. onsite- offshore model.
• At least 4 years of experience in SDLC methodologies such as Waterfall or Agile (preferred)
• At least 4 years of experience in Project life cycle activities on development, maintenance projects.
• Candidates should possess knowledge to build and configuration management related process.
• Technical aptitude and experience with the software tools and techniques used in software development.
• Must be able to collaborate with offshore team 
• Candidates should have high analytical ability and impactful communication with stakeholders.
• Ability to participate into requirements analysis, estimation, development and code reviews activities.
• Ability to effectively prioritize and execute any tasks with quality and track it to closure.
• Experience in credit cards and Payments domain would be a plus.
• Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment


 Basic 

 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education. 
 • At least 4 years of experience with Information Technologies 


 Additional Information 

** U.S. citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply. 

 Note:- 

1.This is a Full-Time Permanent job opportunity for you.
2.Only US Citizen, Green Card Holder can apply.
3.No OPT-EAD & H1B Consultants please.
4.Please mention your Visa Status in your email or resume.
